text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Heheheh. You saw that, right, Trainie?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Inside the heat-filled venue... the thrilling and exciting "unknown" began with a resounding clatter!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Defying predictions, sparks flying, pushing even further beyond!
The whole thing is just the abso-lute beeeest!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: And so, I reckon a race run with all yer might is truly supreme. The End!
choice_data_list: Keep that spirit up and let's do our best next time too.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Do you see it, Trainy?!
That run guided the entire racetrack into the 'unknown'!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
This is the culmination of Train-chan and my...
sweat, tears, special training, info, cheering, and bonds!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
While politely asking for your continued guidance and encouragement...
Once again, the end!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh? Trai-nee, we're already moving on to the next topic~?
Where's your sense of lingering afterglow, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Just kidding.
It's not like I'm satisfied just having one wild blast, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: On to the next thrill... on to the next 'unknown'! Counting on your support tomorrow too, got it?
